exposure: Primary selective reduction by cord occlusion (CO)
outcome: Procedure-related complications (preterm premature rupture of membranes, post-laser twin-anemia polycythemia sequence)
cohort: The study included all pregnancies undergoing TTTS surgery between May 2019 and April 2022 in the Nordic countries.
finding: FLP resulted in at least one surviving neonate in 86% and at least two survivors in 64%, with a median GA at delivery of 32+2 weeks, while the CO group achieved at least one surviving neonate in 80% of cases.
gest_age: Median GA at surgery was 20+1 weeks (range 15+1; 29+0), and median GA at delivery was 32+2 weeks (range 24+3; 41+0).
